outcome.reason: The recommendations-api deployment has 2 replicas configured with required hostname-level pod anti-affinity (podAntiAffinity.requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution matching app.kubernetes.io/name=recommendations-api with topologyKey kubernetes.io/hostname). In the single-node cluster (vm-4), only one replica could be scheduled (recommendations-api-599d96d7cd-bh6xs) while the second replica (recommendations-api-599d96d7cd-6ztpf) remained in Pending state due to FailedScheduling (1 node(s) didn't match pod anti-affinity rules). Node resources (CPU/memory/PIDs) are sufficient and no taints or pressures block scheduling. To resolve the deadlock, the required anti-affinity rule must be relaxed to preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution or configured with a satisfiable topology domain.
